GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (17 Sep 46) LS-A
(SCAPIN-1208)
APO 500
17 September 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Results of War Crimes Trials.
1. Notice is hereby given of the following results of War Crimes Trials as reported by British Authorities.
ACCUSED DESIGNATION PLACE OF TRIAL RESULT OF TRIAL
MATSUDA, Kenichi Sgt., attached CHENG MOK TAN Gendarmerie, HONG KONG. East Point Godown Guilty. 8 years Imprisonment.
TARUMOTO, Jugi Capt., attached 9th Railway Regt., BURMA Singapore Guilty. Life Imprisonment.
ORINO, Hirshi Lt., attached 74th Independent Company attached Supply Depot SINGAPORE. Singapore Guilty. 15 years Imprisonment.
NAGAYAMA, Kanjiro L/Cpl., attached 74th Independent Company attached Supply Depot SINGAPORE. Singapore Guilty. 7 years Imprisonment.
HIRAKAWA, Mitsuki Lt., attached 12th Special Base, ANDAMANS Singapore Guilty. 10 years Imprisonment.
EGAMI, Masao Lt., attached 9th Tpt. Unit. Singapore Guilty. 10 years Imprisonment.
SHINDO, (K)Hisatoro SPO., attached 12th Naval Base, ANDAMANS Singapore Acquitted.
KOBAYASHI, Matsuo Capt., attached 37th Indep. Mixed Bde., Kamorate, NICOBAR. Singapore Guilty. 4 years Imprisonment. (5 months remitted)
FUJITA. Masao Int., attached 37th Indep. Mixed Bde., Kamorate, NICOBAR. Singapore Guilty. 3 years Imprisonment. (5 months remitted)
TANIGUCHI, Bunshiro Civ., attached 12th Spec. Naval Base. Singapore Guilty. 15 years Imprisonment.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
